text: I've been dealing with this cough for over six months, and yes, it produces white phlegm. speaker: Doctor

text: RESULTS: Chest_X-Ray: Hyperinflation of the lungs, flattened diaphragms; Spirometry (Pulmonary_Function_Test): FEV1 65% of predicted, FVC 75% of predicted, FEV1/FVC Ratio 0.60 (decreased)

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) with emphysema and chronic bronchitis. Given your age, smoking history, and the combination of hyperinflated lungs on X-ray with an obstructive pattern on spirometry (FEV1/FVC < 0.70), this confirms the diagnosis. I recommend starting a long-acting bronchodilator and scheduling a smoking cessation consultation immediately.
